name: Rue des Gestes — étape 13 · repousser, se hisser, abattre
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (man pushing back a charging goat with his broom, man hoisting himself up a rope onto the wall while a goose hisses, little mirror on the wall; man chaining his bicycle to the balcony rail; cook trapping a jay under a pie dish at the upper window; farmer mowing the grass roof with a scythe), -ir/-re RIGHT (man knocking down a tower of tin cans with a cricket bat). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.

items.mirror: small oval mirror on the wall beside the rope
